strategy.summary: Reproduce the UBSAN-only crash in scipy.special.eval_gegenbauer when n is NaN. The developer test adds n=np.nan to test_gegenbauer_nan. Plain builds may not show the transition, so the reproduction needs a clang build with UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer that aborts on the first report. The buggy commit 52e053991b6a should abort with SIGILL in that test, and the fixed revision should collect and pass all 45 parameter combinations.

build_commands: CC=clang CXX=clang++ CFLAGS=-fno-sanitize-recover=all LDFLAGS=-fsanitize=undefined python -m pip install --no-build-isolation -e . -Csetup-args=-Db_sanitize=undefined
pinned_because: NumPy <=2.3 is an era ceiling inferred from the PR date only (2026-07-23); no documented constraint was stated, so it is a preference not a requirement
Cython <=3.0 is an era ceiling inferred from the PR date only; version not stated by evidence and not numerically relevant
Clang with UBSAN is required because the reported failure only appears under the clang Undefined Behavior Sanitizer, per the observed behaviour

strategy.reproducing_test: test_gegenbauer_nan parametrized over n in [0, 1, 2, 3.2, np.nan], alpha in [0.0, 1, np.nan], x in [1e-6, 2, np.nan], i.e. 45 cases, with the new n=np.nan entry from the developer diff.
strategy.success_criterion: On the buggy revision 52e053991b6a in a clang UBSAN build with halt_on_error, the test process aborts with illegal instruction at the double-to-long-long conversion of n when n=nan is reached, so the test run fails or crashes. On the fixed revision the same command collects the 45 cases and all pass with no UBSAN report.
strategy.numerical_probe: UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1 python -c 'import numpy as np; from scipy.special import eval_gegenbauer; print(eval_gegenbauer(np.nan, 0.0, 0.5))'

input_output_examples.input: eval_gegenbauer(n=nan, alpha=0.0 or 1 or nan, x=1e-6 or 2 or nan) in a clang UBSAN build
input_output_examples.buggy_output: illegal instruction crash from UBSAN-flagged illegal double-to-long-long conversion of n
input_output_examples.expected_output: no undefined behaviour or crash; API unchanged

risks: Without a UBSAN build the buggy code may not fail: on x86 the NaN-to-integer conversion yields a sentinel value and the test may still pass on the buggy revision, so the transition is not guaranteed outside the sanitizer build.
The reported failure is UBSAN-specific and clang-specific; GCC or non-sanitizer builds will not reproduce it, so the transition cannot be obtained there.

Architecture dependence: the UB report and SIGILL behaviour were observed under clang UBSAN and may differ on ARM64 or other platforms; the reproduction assumes Linux x86_64 and is untested elsewhere.

The fix still evaluates the long long cast of n before the n == comparison in the same expression, so the fixed revision may still trigger UBSAN on NaN. If so the transition would fail; the passages do not resolve this, and it is the main risk to a passing fixed run.
Unrelated UB elsewhere in NumPy or SciPy under UBSAN could abort the pytest run before reaching this test; -k test_gegenbauer_nan limits collection but not library-level reports.
Expected numeric values and tolerances for the NaN cases are not given in the evidence; the test checks NaN handling, so oracle precision cannot be verified from the context.
Negative n and n >= 1e10 take the general recurrence path; the evidence gives no expected values for them, so they are not checked by this reproduction.

oracle.why: The test checks NaN propagation and absence of crash; the evidence gives no numeric expected outputs or tolerances.

strategy.fails_on_buggy: In a plain build the assertions may pass on the buggy revision. In a clang UBSAN build with halt_on_error, the buggy code performs an illegal double-to-long-long conversion of NaN and the process aborts with SIGILL before the assertions, so the test fails.
strategy.passes_on_fixed: With the guard n == <long long> n and n >= 0 and n < 1e10 in the fixed revision, the NaN path avoids the illegal conversion, so the UBSAN run completes and all 45 cases pass, provided the cast ordering does not still trigger UBSAN.
